notes.title: Delays release date to June 2023
notes.content:
Dear friends, in order to add more interesting content to the game and conduct stability tests, we have to postpone the release date by half a year to the end of June 2023.
At that time, we will also participate in the New Product Festival in June and provide a prologue Demo for everyone to play.
I am very sorry to make you wait more, please give us some more time, we will dedicate our best works to you.

Thanks
Sincerely, Strike Zero Development Team
